description.default: The FORNO ROSSO front door: the demo's headline over a charred oven glow, with tonight's real numbers read live from the running factory.

properties.headline: The trattoria that runs itself
properties.lede: Right now, in a real Azure deployment, a pizza factory is taking orders, resting dough, baking, seating guests and reordering its own ingredients from an outside supplier — with nobody at the controls.
